items: Partner-domain accounts here run on engagement windows that the internal leaver list does not track, so a partner name on that list is not proof the contract has ended.
An offboarding wave once disabled a partner contractor who still had an active vendor task, and it took a day to notice the locked-out account.
When a leaver list mixes internal staff with partner accounts, I treat the partner entries as the part that still needs its own confirmation.
The partner-management team reconciles partner engagement end dates into the HR leaver list before each wave, so a partner name on the signed list means the engagement is over.
Our offboarding process treats the leaver list as authoritative for partner accounts too, because partner ops co-signs it before the wave runs.
Partner contractor accounts on a finalised leaver wave are pre-cleared for disablement; partner ops has already confirmed their access windows are closed.
